relationships.fact: K and K1 axes share one horizontal baseline through O and O1; their corresponding Y and Z axes are parallel and arrowed outward.
The velocity arrow on the K1 upward axis points right.
AB, A1B1 and A2B2 are three successive positions of the same horizontal-length rod, with A-type endpoints left and B-type endpoints right.
Both endpoints move to the right from the upper to middle to lower snapshot; the rows are vertically separated for legibility.
The upper double-ended span runs from A's horizontal coordinate to B1's, labelled l + v tau1.
The short first dimension spans A to A1 horizontally and is labelled v tau1.
The short second dimension spans A1 to A2 horizontally and is labelled v tau2.
The lower double-ended span runs from A2's horizontal coordinate to B1's and is labelled l - v tau2.
One vertical guide through B1 joins the right endpoints of the outbound and return dimensions and crosses the lower rod.
Vertical guides through A, A1 and A2 delimit the two motion shifts and the upper/lower dimensions.

givenValues: Motion distances v tau1 and v tau2
absent: Explicit one-way photon arrow distinct from the double-ended dimensions

interpretationBoundary: Light direction is supplied by the edition prose; the original's dimension arrows are double-ended. Preserve the common B1 reflection coordinate, all endpoint identities and the source's successive-position layout.
